d:
For some reason, this work by Gekka Kaguya has never been translated, although the rest of the mangas in the tank it is in do have translations (Futanari Bengoshi)

English is not my native language, so let me know if there are things with the syntax or anything else. I took the opportunity to practice both English and Japanese, although I do not deny that I used the help of translators where my knowledge was not enough.
n: [Manga] [Gekka Kaguya] 3-nen F-gumi Karasuma-sensei  | Karasuma-sensei Third Year Class F(COMIC Mugen Tensei 2020-11) [English]
